description: Creates, resizes or removes LVM Physical Volumes.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Path to the block device to manage.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force the operation. When state=present (creating a PV), this uses pvcreate -f to force creation. When state=absent (removing a PV), this uses pvremove -ff to force removal even if part of a volume group. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: resize
parameters.description: Resize PV to device size when state=present. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Control if the physical volume exists. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

examples:
- name: Creating physical volume on /dev/sdb
  community.general.lvm_pv:
    device: /dev/sdb

- name: Creating and resizing (if needed) physical volume
  community.general.lvm_pv:
    device: /dev/sdb
    resize: true

- name: Removing physical volume that is not part of any volume group
  community.general.lvm_pv:
    device: /dev/sdb
    state: absent

- name: Force removing physical volume that is already part of a volume group
  community.general.lvm_pv:
    device: /dev/sdb
    force: true
    state: absent
